articles.title: Programmatic M&A in Australia: The most reliable way to unlock value
articles.summary: Fewer than one in 20 Australian-listed companies pursued programmatic M&A over the past decade, but they delivered the highest excess shareholder returns of any cohort.

articles.title: Rural healthcare and America’s $340 billion workforce earnings opportunity
articles.summary: Rural facilities are closing as staffing shortages worsen. Yet 38 million “bridge workers”—nearly 100 times the national workforce shortage—could move into nursing and allied health roles and gain economic mobility.

articles.title: Proving AI’s business value: Views from PayPal Ads SVP and GM Mark Grether
articles.summary: PayPal Ads’ Mark Grether describes how marketers connect technology investment to measurable outcomes by using proprietary transaction data, CMO–CFO alignment, and changes to customer journeys.

articles.title: The Achilles’ heel of global trade: Building resilience where it matters most
articles.summary: International trade has been resilient, but important vulnerabilities lurk beneath the surface. Identifying and managing these Achilles’ heels could help unlock new markets, products, and economic growth.

articles.title: Reinventing business planning with agentic AI
articles.summary: Combining better forecasting with AI agents will turn planning into a more continuous, intelligent, and responsive decision-making system—and reduce the manual work required to turn forecasts into action.
